newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil flat, listless ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil flat, listless ahead of holiday.

text.p: NWE high and low sulphur cracked fuel oil markets were becalmed on Tuesday as traders awaited the New Year's holiday.

High sulphur ARA barges were little changed and dealers said that Esso had sold a couple of pieces at $113 fob ARA. That followed problems with the refinery's flexi-coker, which company officials said was in the process of being restarted.
While declining to say exactly when the unit would be fully operational, the officials said they were likely to manage the restart within a week or so.
Low sulphur barges were not talked.
High and low sulphur cargoes were very quiet and notionally unchanged but dealers said they expected a busy start to the new year.
"There could be a flurry of activity. There are quite a few cargoes around and there is a lot to be cleared out," one U.K.-based player said.
